title: Implement a Stack class in Python
description: Implement push, pop, peek, is_empty, and size on a Stack class. All methods raise NotImplementedError.

files.tests/test_stack.py:
import pytest
from stack import Stack

def test_empty_on_init():
    s = Stack()
    assert s.is_empty()
    assert s.size() == 0

def test_push_peek():
    s = Stack()
    s.push(1)
    assert s.peek() == 1
    assert s.size() == 1
    assert not s.is_empty()

def test_push_pop():
    s = Stack()
    s.push(1)
    s.push(2)
    assert s.pop() == 2
    assert s.pop() == 1
    assert s.is_empty()

def test_pop_empty_raises():
    s = Stack()
    with pytest.raises(IndexError):
        s.pop()

def test_peek_empty_raises():
    s = Stack()
    with pytest.raises(IndexError):
        s.peek()

def test_size_multiple():
    s = Stack()
    for i in range(5):
        s.push(i)
    assert s.size() == 5

task_spec.prompt:
Implement the Stack class in src/stack.py. The stack should be backed by a Python list. Requirements:
- __init__: initialize an empty internal list
- push(item): append item to the list
- pop(): remove and return the last item; raise IndexError if empty
- peek(): return the last item without removing it; raise IndexError if empty
- is_empty(): return True if the stack has no items
- size(): return the number of items
All 6 tests must pass. Run `pytest tests/ -v --rootdir=. -p no:cacheprovider` to verify.
